pairs.gold_text: The operator revised its policy during the later response.
pairs.system_text: The mine operator revised its policy following the slide.

pairs.gold_text: Yelverton Minerals and mines inspectorate met during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Yelverton Minerals and the mines inspectorate met during the response.

pairs.gold_text: Ashfell slide damaged the lower road.
pairs.system_text: A bench failure at the Ashfell site damaged the lower road below Withel terraces.

pairs.gold_text: Damage was reported in Dreth and the Pellan during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Damage was reported in the town of Dreth and in the Pellan.

pairs.gold_text: The lower road was restored during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: The lower road was restored at the end of the operational window.

pairs.gold_text: Service at the lower road was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Service on the lower road was disrupted in the closing hours of the window.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Corvane mine was disrupted during the Ashfell slide.
pairs.system_text: Service at the Corvane mine was disrupted following the slide.

unmatched_system.text: Service was disrupted in the upper bench at the Ashfell workings.

pairs.gold_text: 60 households were displaced from Cranmoor during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: Sixty households were displaced from Cranmoor by the end of the window.

unmatched_system.text: Residents moved away from Cranmoor as displacement continued late in the window.

pairs.gold_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: About 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces after the warning was issued.

pairs.gold_text: People were evacuated from the bench during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: People were evacuated from the upper bench at Ashfell on the third day.

unmatched_system.text: Residents were also evacuated from Cranmoor under the same order.
The primary hazard was failure of the bench above Withel, which sent material onto the lower road.
The Corvane tailings dam and its associated pond were identified as a further hazard at the site.
Information was provided about the Corvane tailings dam and the tailings pond.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor on the first day.

unmatched_system.text: Successive evacuation orders covered Withel terraces, Cranmoor and the upper bench at Ashfell.
